name: BADEN CLOUD / Baden-RZ Baden-Baden data center
notes: BADEN CLOUD lists Baden-Baden as a regional data center location; Stiegeler states brain4kom was integrated into the Stiegeler group. Capacity not publicly stated.

name: Liebherr-Werk Biberach graphics/CAD data center platform
notes: Trade press reported Liebherr-Werk Biberach delivering graphics-intensive applications via a data center to distributed users. Enterprise/internal facility; no public MW capacity.

name: TeleData data center in Immenstaad am Bodensee
notes: TeleData states it operates a high-security data center in Immenstaad am Bodensee, offering housing, IaaS/cloud, managed backup and hosting; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: AtlasEdge STR001 / Hulb-West Böblingen data center
notes: Periskop announced the Hulb-West data center opened in mid-July 2025 and is operated by AtlasEdge; DCD/Liberty Global report STR001 in the Böblingen area will deliver 20 MW across 10,000 sqm at full build-out.

name: ITENOS Stuttgart 2 / STR2 Böblingen data center
notes: ITENOS says its Böblingen STR2 data center currently has 1,600 sqm, expandable to 8,000 sqm and 24 MW at completion; page describes EN 50600 VK3 certification and 100% renewable power.

name: Sparkassen-IT / levigo Rechenzentrum in Calw
notes: levigo states it has operated its own IT infrastructure in the Sparkassen-IT data center in Calw since 2016, using it for backup, storage, housing and cloud services. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Abrechnungszentrum Emmendingen data center
notes: The organization's own site says it operates its own highly secure data center; local/partner reports describe visits to the data center and backup power. Capacity not disclosed.

name: Birkenfeld datacenter/server-hosting conversion property
developer: Webmanager GmbH / property owner (marketing a conversion site)
notes: Commercial listing in Birkenfeld, Enzkreis markets a 4,304 sqm former factory as suitable for edge compute, regional colocation, managed hosting, private cloud or micro datacenter use; listing cites existing 800 kVA transformer, expandable to about 1,500 kVA. Not evidence of a committed operator.

name: Hochschule Esslingen Rechenzentrum
notes: University IT service page states the data center operates more than 220 servers and central IT services across the university. Institutional center; no public MW capacity.
